jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer — Distributed Systems & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
EchoSphere is pioneering autonomous multi-persona conversational AI agent systems for enterprise hiring and technical evaluation. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to lead the architecture, scaling, and operational reliability of our core real-time inference and voice orchestration platform.

In this role, you will design ultra-low-latency backend microservices bridging WebRTC media pipelines, streaming LLM inference gateways, and transactional persistence layers. You will directly own the infrastructure handling thousands of concurrent real-time audio streams, WebSocket event loops, and distributed state coordination.

Key Responsibilities:
• Architect, deploy, and scale high-concurrency microservices in Python (FastAPI/asyncio) and Go to support thousands of simultaneous voice interview sessions.
• Optimize database schemas, indexing strategies, and connection pooling across PostgreSQL clusters and Redis caching layers.
• Build fault-tolerant event ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka and Redis Pub/Sub with sub-50ms p99 latency targets.
• Implement robust observability, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), and auto-healing infrastructure for mission-critical AI workloads.
• Collaborate with our AI Research and WebRTC teams to streamline model deployment, GPU batching, and semantic context caching.
jobs.requirements:
Required Qualifications:
• 5+ years of software engineering experience building and maintaining distributed backend systems in production.
• Deep proficiency in Python (FastAPI, asyncio, Celery) or Go, with comprehensive knowledge of concurrent programming and asynchronous I/O.
• Strong expertise in relational databases (PostgreSQL query optimization, partitioning, indexing, connection pooling) and key-value caches (Redis).
• Proven track record designing and maintaining high-throughput, low-latency REST and WebSocket APIs under strict SLAs.
• Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, partition tolerance, eventual consistency, and idempotent design.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with real-time media streaming, WebRTC, or voice AI pipelines (Agora, LiveKit, Deepgram, Twilio).
• Familiarity with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, AWS/GCP).
• Prior experience deploying or scaling LLM inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton).
jobs.stagesJson: ["Technical Architecture & Concurrency","Distributed System Design","Engineering Leadership & Cultural Alignment"]

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer — Next.js & Real-Time WebRTC
jobs.description:
Join EchoSphere's core product team to build the next generation of real-time AI interview rooms, collaborative proctoring systems, and enterprise ATS dashboards. We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead our frontend architecture and full-stack product interfaces.

You will bridge cutting-edge browser technologies (WebRTC, Web Audio API, Canvas, Web Workers) with Next.js 15+ App Router architectures to deliver responsive, zero-lag, mission-critical voice interview experiences used by global talent teams.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead full-stack development across candidate-facing live interview rooms and recruiter administrative dashboards.
• Implement high-performance WebRTC client audio/video handling, real-time waveform visualizers, and stateful turn arbiters.
• Design scalable Next.js architectures utilizing React Server Components, server actions, and optimistic UI updates.
• Optimize client-side compute performance to support simultaneous background audio processing and proctoring analytics without dropping frames.
• Build accessible, beautiful UI components with Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and modern component design systems.
jobs.requirements:
Required Qualifications:
• 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience building responsive, high-scale web applications.
• Mastery of modern TypeScript, React, and Next.js (App Router, Server Components, SSR/SSG).

• Deep proficiency with modern state management, Tailwind CSS, and component design patterns.
• Solid backend foundation in Node.js / Next.js API route handlers, REST APIs, and database integration.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity with client-side ML / computer vision (MediaPipe, TensorFlow.js) in the browser.
• Experience designing responsive, accessible, enterprise SaaS design systems.

jobs.title: Staff AI / Machine Learning Engineer — Speech & Conversational LLMs
jobs.description:
EchoSphere is pushing the frontier of multimodal real-time conversational agents. As a Staff AI / Machine Learning Engineer, you will drive the core models behind our multi-persona voice interviewers, evaluation scoring rubrics, and automated profile synthesis engines.

You will lead research, fine-tuning, and production serving of multimodal speech-to-speech and large language models, optimizing for sub-500ms voice turnaround latency, natural conversational turn-taking, and rigorous, bias-free candidate evaluation.

Key Responsibilities:
• Train, fine-tune, and optimize state-of-the-art LLMs (Llama, Gemini Live, Mistral) for specialized interviewing personas and domain-specific technical probing.
• Architect real-time voice intelligence pipelines integrating streaming ASR, low-latency LLM generation, and expressive neural TTS.
• Design advanced multi-round evaluation rubrics with automated chain-of-thought grading, grounded retrieval (RAG), and calibrated confidence scoring.
• Implement techniques to eliminate hallucinations, enforce floor-control turn arbitration, and ensure fair, objective candidate assessments.
• Optimize model inference latency and throughput on GPU clusters using TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and speculative decoding.
jobs.requirements:
Required Qualifications:
• 5+ years of experience developing and deploying production machine learning models and LLM applications.
• Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem, and modern deep learning frameworks.
• Deep experience fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO/RLHF) and building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.
• Solid understanding of conversational AI architectures, acoustic models, streaming speech recognition, and neural audio synthesis.
• Solid foundation in machine learning system design, latency optimization, and distributed GPU serving.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Published research or open-source contributions in NLP, Speech Recognition, or Conversational Agents.
• Experience with Triton Inference Server, vLLM, DeepSpeed, or ONNX Runtime.
• Prior work in automated bias mitigation, fairness metrics, or enterprise talent assessment models.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer — Kubernetes & GPU Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to design, automate, and harden our cloud foundation. You will own the Kubernetes clusters, GPU compute nodes, CI/CD pipelines, and multi-region networking that power EchoSphere's live voice sessions globally.

You will ensure 99.99% uptime, automated zero-downtime deployments, zero-trust security compliance, and elastic auto-scaling under fluctuating real-time interview traffic.

Key Responsibilities:
• Architect and maintain enterprise cloud infrastructure across AWS / GCP using Terraform and GitOps (ArgoCD).
• Manage and scale production Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) clusters with dynamic GPU node autoscaling for AI inference workloads.
• Design resilient CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, automated regression testing, and security vulnerability scanning.
• Implement comprehensive observability stacks with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and structured logging.
• Establish enterprise security baselines: SOC 2 compliance, KMS secret management, network isolation (VPC peering, WAF, Cloudflare).
jobs.requirements:
Required Qualifications:
• 4+ years of dedicated DevOps, Site Reliability, or Cloud Infrastructure Engineering experience.
• Deep hands-on expertise with Kubernetes container orchestration, Helm, and ingress controllers.
• Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and configuration management in AWS or GCP.
• Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go.
• Experience maintaining production networking: DNS, load balancers, CDN routing, VPC architectures, and TLS termination.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience managing GPU workloads (NVIDIA GPU Operator, CUDA drivers, Triton deployment on Kubernetes).
• Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, or ISO 27001 compliance standards in enterprise SaaS environments.
• Experience optimizing cloud spend, spot instance orchestration, and reserved capacity planning.
